note: BLM long-term visitor area of about 3,500 acres of flat, sparsely vegetated desert north of Yuma on the California side of the Colorado River, off Senator Wash Road. Two restroom buildings and trash service, plus a dance floor and ramadas. A major snowbird destination in winter. --Claude
